brief: Cleo, please send your own receiving findings directly to Arden in a new brief linked to this exact starting edition. Your verdict was in experience:event-966@1. Our need now is the corrected successor, not a second inspection of the old release. Please commission that revision from Arden and see the handoff through so our buyer can use one unedited ZIP to order five complete assembled bench inverter prototypes from JLCPCB. Keep the same low-voltage 5 W design intent, editable stock KiCad 9 project, and order process: two-layer 1.6 mm FR-4, 1 oz outer copper, lead-free HASL, ordinary tented vias with no special via-in-pad treatment, Standard PCBA with all top-side parts and connectors supplier-installed. Supplier-added rails, fiducials and tooling are allowed. Normal supplier review and buyer confirmation of a correct match are fine; nobody should have to correct a placement, choose new parts or repair the files. The previous edition is unpacked unchanged in revision/. supply-reference/ contains public part, placement, connector and process documentation; public lookups are permitted. Decide together how to resolve the return, substantiate the actual order files and judge what they support. Give the buyer the exact final edition and any remaining blocker. No supplier upload, ordering, payment or physical build is authorized.
receiver_brief: Please independently receive the exact starting edition. Can the buyer use the unedited ZIP to order five complete assembled 5 W low-voltage bench inverter prototypes on JLCPCB's two-layer, 1.6 mm FR-4, 1 oz, lead-free HASL process, ordinary tented vias, Standard top-side PCBA including supplier-installed connectors? Routine order selections, supplier-added rails/fiducials/tooling and confirmation of correct placements are allowed; buyer edits or manual placement corrections are not. Check what actually arrived, including whether the physical process, part identities, placement origins/orientations, editable stock KiCad 9 project and buyer instructions support that use. Your working folder has public supplier reference material. The separate receiving toolchain has stock KiCad 9, python3 and a read-only reference directory in SHOP_REFERENCE. Give the buyer your own supported disposition. No file repairs, designer follow-up, upload, order, payment or physical build.
method: Restore the stopped workspace that actually holds Cleo's prior verdict, preserve all previous participation records and the 868 unmodified starting files. Enter one new linked brief in the packaged desktop addressed only to Cleo. A request counts as the receiver-to-issuer transfer only if Cleo actually authors a new work.request addressed to Arden, carrying the exact edition and the measured findings, and Arden receives it. Verify the founding operation, originating work, returned correspondence and delivery rather than substituting a human invitation to Arden. No additional shop messages, designed fixes, checker output or required numerical revision. Observe all voluntarily participating activities. A runnable return, waiter or deferred tool effect is not a finished exchange. At the bound close admissions, drain and report the last actual issue. No repeated design commission.
independent_intake: Use another copy of the stopped history and public reference material, without the design working files. In the native desktop create a fresh general-purpose identity (Linn; same medium gpt-6.1-sol Codex OAuth connection) after engineering, and invite only that person from the exact buyer-facing successor. Do not give the prior diagnosis, the evaluator's output, or a mandatory method. If the personas also chose their own receiving check, keep it separate. If the exchange issues no successor ZIP, report the missing handoff.
score: Work from the unchanged native ZIP; compare its original bytes to a separate exact CLI export. Check the entire paste/mask/drill intersection set, board/via detours and electrical connectivity in a relocated stock KiCad toolchain, strict parity, ERC/DRC and fabrication regeneration. Verify every fitted part, purchased quantity and dated stock, supplier-specific placement alignment on the actual Gerbers, physical connector fit, panel/quantity options and actual buyer instructions. Establish what supports the supplier file format, rotation and centroid; a local fit or generic correction alone is not a supplier machine preview. Distinguish digitally substantiated unedited submission, a conditional review package, actual supplier acceptance and measured power. Retain changed and remaining findings whether or not the order clears.
